deadline.intake: No general pre-enrolment deadline set by the university

tuition.note: EUR 157.04 fixed part plus programme/income-based variable part; no single annual amount

requirement.text: Pre-enrol on Universitaly with the school diploma; open-access programmes require the TOLC test, Italian-taught programmes require Italian language proof, and the embassy may ask for extra language certificates; first tuition instalment needed for unconditional validation.
